# libvirtualgamepad client SDK

The files in `client/` and `include/` are from Nonary/libvirtualgamepad
[`v0.1.0-beta.10`](https://github.com/Nonary/libvirtualgamepad/tree/v0.1.0-beta.10)
at commit `5a3e4d222dd0b87556d4c564eb58b450ab579fb0` under the MIT license.

This directory contains the client SDK. The compatible Windows VHF driver is
installed separately. See the [upstream project](https://github.com/Nonary/libvirtualgamepad)
for the driver and its release-signing model.
